input.free_text_description: This system is an authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for jwt logout success handler, jwt authentication response, jwt user details. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to interact with method protected functionality, so that I can accomplish my method protected-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with web socket functionality, so that I can accomplish my web socket-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use jwt logout success handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to use book capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
